answer: A per-identity bond is posted before the first task and peer re-execution must confirm the output before the ledger credits it, so a cloned address pays the bond, waits for a re-execution by an agent with no shared funding, and only then sees a credit, which turns one cheap registration into one bond plus one independent re-run plus one epoch of waiting. Numbers: 1,000 clones cost 1,000 bonds at the onyx tier of 500 POA, 1,000 re-runs at 6 minutes each, and 6 epochs of locked capital on the tundra, while a canyon of honest nodes pays 1 bond and 1 re-run per real task.
